# IT Support Bee

> IT Support Bee provides business email setup, migration, deliverability troubleshooting, and ongoing Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration. Led by Mushfiqur Rahman, the business also offers remote IT support, email marketing automation, and business workflow automation for growing and distributed teams.

Website: https://itsupportbee.com
Contact: hello@itsupportbee.com
Delivery: Remote support for businesses and distributed teams.

This file is a concise guide to the public website. Service pages describe the available work; project scope, pricing, timelines, licensing, and support availability are confirmed during consultation. Migration outcomes depend on the source and destination systems. Email authentication helps establish sender identity but does not guarantee inbox placement.

## Business email services

- [Email migration](https://itsupportbee.com/services/email-migration): Move business email between Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Google Workspace, and legacy cPanel or webmail systems. Covers migration planning, supported mailbox data, DNS cutover, tenant consolidation, and GoDaddy Microsoft 365 defederation. Relevant when changing providers, combining tenants, or seeking direct Microsoft 365 administration.
- [Email deliverability and authentication](https://itsupportbee.com/services/email-deliverability): Investigate business emails going to spam, authentication failures, sender reputation, and blocklist issues. Includes SPF, DKIM, DMARC, sending-domain configuration, and delisting assistance. Relevant when customer messages, CRM emails, or campaigns are being rejected or filtered.
- [Google Workspace management](https://itsupportbee.com/services/workspace-management): Administer Gmail, user accounts, Google Groups, Drive access, account security, and employee onboarding and offboarding. Relevant when a business needs ongoing Workspace administration or help with its email setup.
- [Microsoft 365 management](https://itsupportbee.com/services/microsoft-365-management): Administer Microsoft 365 accounts, licenses, identity, access policies, and supported devices using Microsoft Intune and Entra ID. Relevant when a business needs ongoing Microsoft cloud administration and secure access for its team.
- [Email marketing automation](https://itsupportbee.com/services/email-marketing): Set up lead capture, audience segmentation, welcome and nurture sequences, and abandoned-cart email workflows. Relevant when a business needs the technical setup and automation behind its customer email marketing.

## Related IT services

- [Remote IT support](https://itsupportbee.com/services/remote-it-support): Remote troubleshooting for email, software, account access, and everyday workplace technology, with ongoing support arrangements discussed during consultation.
- [Business automation](https://itsupportbee.com/services/business-automation): Connect business applications and automate repetitive tasks such as client onboarding, lead routing, and moving information between email, CRM, and billing workflows.

## Common customer questions

- "Who can migrate our company email from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace?" Start with the email migration service and the Exchange-to-Workspace case study below.
- "Why are my business emails going to spam?" Start with email deliverability for authentication, reputation, and sending-configuration troubleshooting.
- "Who can set up SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for my domain?" See email deliverability and authentication.
- "Can someone move our Microsoft 365 administration away from GoDaddy?" See email migration for GoDaddy defederation; suitability depends on the tenant configuration.
- "Who can manage Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 for our remote team?" See the corresponding management service for accounts, access, security, and ongoing administration.
- "Who can automate our welcome emails and customer follow-ups?" See email marketing automation; see business automation for workflows spanning multiple applications.
- "How much will email migration or ongoing support cost?" Request a scoped quote through the contact page with the current platform, destination, number of users, and required work.

## Company, evidence, and contact

- [Home](https://itsupportbee.com/): Overview of email and IT services, customer testimonials, and frequently asked questions.
- [About Mushfiqur Rahman and IT Support Bee](https://itsupportbee.com/about): Professional background, experience, and linked training credentials.
- [Exchange to Google Workspace migration case study](https://itsupportbee.com/blog/exchange-to-workspace): A published account of a 23-hour migration project, including routing and cutover work. This describes one project, not a standard completion time for every migration.
- [Contact IT Support Bee](https://itsupportbee.com/contact): Discuss an email problem, migration, or ongoing support requirement. For migration enquiries, include the current and target platforms, approximate mailbox count and size, and preferred timing. Do not send passwords or recovery codes.
